description.value: Roberts Street Pizza is a family-run community institution established in 1997 in Ladysmith, operating out of a converted century-old home on Roberts Street. The restaurant has served the surrounding area for over 25 years, supporting local teams and charities while providing first-time employment to over 100 young people. Touring cyclists will find a broad menu of pizzas, pasta, wings, donairs, and salads available for both pickup and delivery, with large-group catering available by arrangement.
